Since a lot of people ask me for updates and what not, I made this thread so you can post it here instead of me forgetting about it later. As well as keeping track of the changes made to the bot/game.

7/9/2015 - moebot 2.0.6

Added !Duel <user>, which requests a western styled shoot of. (Please do not do it a lot in the main channel as it is really spammy) Requested by @Flow

Added !LinkMe <user> which returns the last message that contained a link for that user. Suggested by @Calorie-Kin

Added a blacklist for users and !Ban <user> to ban bad people. (Only Kyle can do this command)

Added spam filter for all commands, harsher on youtube. (1 command per second filter is still in place)

7/3/2015 - moebot 2.0.3

Added !Youtube <search> and url parser. Requested by @Mokum.

6/30/2015 - moebot 2.0.2

Added !Praise/Worship as an alternative to !Bang when the Voat Goat or a Snoo appears. Suggested by a lot of people.

Changed version numbering -- it was getting out of hand.

Added Voat Goat spawn. When a player attempts to !Bang moebot will put the user in time-out for an hour, which disables all commands, your attempted murder count goes up by 1 as well.

Added Super Snoos, when no one shoots a snoo within 30 seconds to a minute it will evolve into a Super Snoo, which requires 50 kills to shoot. When no one shoots a Super Snoo after ~1 minute it will revert back to normal. Somewhat suggested by @CyanRyan

Added a 10% miss chance when using !Bang. Suggested by @normal_dude

Miss chance can be changed via !Miss <#> Requested by someone. (Only Kyle can do this command)

6/26/2015 - moebot 1.8

Added !Spawn <range>, which sets the length of the time for spawns. If no range length is set, a spawn happens immediately only one time and the range stays the same as before. (Only Kyle can do this command)

Changed "A Snoo has appeared!" to "A wild Snoo appeared!" (Pokemon reference). Suggested by @SurvivorType.

6/25/2015 - moebot 1.7

Added !Uguu links some uguu video from youtube. Requested by @moe

6/24/2015 - moebot 1.6

Added !Time used to look up how long until the animal spawns. (Only Kyle can do this command)

Changed animal to be Snoo, and only Kyle can use !Animal now.

Added url completion for v/ & u/ & user/ in text. (i.g i like /v/voat > response https://voat.co/v/voat))
